messages:
micah: dropped a tiny sketch called 'Pinboard' 12; idea: micro-rail at top of left nav to surface pinned deep-links and breadcrumbs that include a small context pill. goal: easier sharing and less nav noise. thoughts on routes + a11y?

ana: love the idea. question: will pins change canonical routes or just store a composed URL? i prefer pins to resolve to canonical server routes so runbooks keep working.

quentin: agree on canonical routes. proposal: canonical paths stay flat (/models/:id, /deployments/:id). pinboard items can include query/hash state for panels: /models/42?tab=metrics#panel=latency

sun: accessibility items: when a pin opens a panel via hash, move focus to the panel heading and announce via aria-live "Opened metrics for Model 42". also ensure the pin buttons are accessible (aria-pressed, keyboard focus)

claire: breadcrumb UX: prefer compact crumbs like "Model  Foo" plus a small pill that reads "metrics" when relevant. pill should be focusable and removable to jump back to resource root

micah: implementation note: we can add lightweight redirects for old routes so bookmarks keep working for 6 months. will include server alias mapping in the RFC.

quentin: small routing contract: keep base routes stable, allow read-only query keys (range, env), use hash for client-only panels. share tokens optional: /models/42/metrics?token=abc123 (expires)

ana: copy suggestion: Pinboard label -> "Pins". tooltip: "Pin a view to quickly share or return to this exact panel". toggle for including UI state: "Include open panels & tab state"

sun: a11y checklist for PR: keyboard nav, aria-current on breadcrumb last item, aria-live announcement on deep-link, visible focus ring for pills, skip-link target updates on route change

claire: analytics: capture origin: pin|breadcrumb|nav, and whether permalink included UI state. helps measure if pins replace long-run bookmarks

micah: i'll update figma with focus flows and example routes and draft the RFC for redirects + token lifecycle. attaching samples in thread:
```
/models/42
/models/42?range=7d#panel=metrics
/deployments/d-9/instances
```

nav-bot: figma updated: https://figma.redwood/pinboard-v1 (comments enabled) :robot_face:

quentin: QA items to add to PR template: landing focus, back-button after pin navigation, redirect alias behaviour, token expiry handling, keyboard removal of pill

micah: thanks all 14; i'll file PR with checklist and RFC link later today.
